props.name: message
props.description: The ICU pattern — "{count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}".

props.name: values
props.description: Values for the arguments the pattern names.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for plural rules, numbers and dates.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Rendered instead when the pattern does not parse. Defaults to the raw pattern.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the parse error when the pattern does not parse.
